title: Criminal Attempt
grade_or_penalty: Same degree as the target crime; attempt of a 1st-degree crime is 2nd degree, except attempted murder (1st degree) (2C:5-4)
key_points: Purposely doing what would be a crime if the facts were as the actor believed, or taking a substantial step strongly corroborating criminal purpose.
Renunciation of purpose before completion can be a defense.
